sources.name: Humboldt Research Fellowship
sources.note: Recurring programme. Entry maintained from the published cycle (15 Mar / 15 Jul / 15 Nov), verified 2026-07-29 — not scraped daily.

sources.name: JSPS International Fellowships
sources.note: Recurring programme. FY2027 deadlines published: 2026-08-28 and 2027-04-23 (host institution submits). Verified 2026-07-29.

sources.name: QuakeCoRE (NZ)
sources.note: Recurring earthquake-resilience funding rounds. Site blocklists AI crawlers, so it is not crawled; the entry carries the published cycle.

sources.name: EURAXESS
sources.note: robots.txt disallows /jobs/* and /*? — the search and every detail page. Not polled; respected, not worked around. The single biggest coverage loss for European structural engineering.

sources.name: Nature Careers
sources.note: robots.txt disallows the job search and RSS, and blocks AI agents by name. Not polled.

sources.name: HigherEdJobs
sources.note: WAF challenge on all paths. Not pollable.

sources.name: FindAPostDoc
sources.note: 403s on listing paths; the one responding route served 2017-vintage postings. Excluded as a stale-data hazard.

sources.name: JREC-IN Portal (Japan)
sources.note: Failed the control probe on 2026-07-28: invalid job IDs returned complete plausible postings. Not trusted by plain fetch.

sources.name: Purdue careers portal
sources.note: Failed the control probe (soft-200 on invalid URLs) and renders via JavaScript. Excluded.

sources.name: University of Canterbury NZ jobs
sources.note: robots.txt disallows the jobs host outright. Not polled, despite NZ's strength in earthquake engineering.

sources.name: JS-only portals (DTU, NTNU, Bristol, SNSF, DAAD, MSCA portal, EPFL, Polimi, HKUST)
sources.note: Listings render only in JavaScript (or the domain blocks AI agents / times out), invisible to this fetcher. Several likely have JSON APIs — future work, tracked in the README.
